	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }

		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 35.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 5.0 } }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_p }

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:aeroplanes.state_goods_production } }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 80 } }
		}

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:porcelain.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 70 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 70 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 122.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 17.5 } }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:porcelain value = local_var:stl_p }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:porcelain value = local_var:stl_e }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:porcelain value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- luxury_clothes (base 60) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:luxury_clothes.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:luxury_clothes.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}

		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 60 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 60 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 105.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 15.0 } }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_p }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_e }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- luxury_furniture (base 60) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 60 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 60 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 105.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 15.0 } }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_p }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_e }

			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- automobiles (base 100) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:automobiles.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:automobiles.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_sell > local_var:stl_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_e > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 100 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_buy }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_sell >= local_var:stl_buy } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = { value = local_var:stl_buy subtract = local_var:stl_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_ratio value = -1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 100 } }
		}
		else = {
			# pure consumer looks expensive, pure producer looks cheap
			if = { limit = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 175.0 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 25.0 } }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_p }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_e }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_sell > 0.01 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
	# --- telephones (base 70) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_buy value = { value = sg:telephones.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_sell value = { value = sg:telephones.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_e value = local_var:stl_buy }
	if = {

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = { value = local_var:stl_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 80 } }

			if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_buy > local_var:stl_sell } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_p value = 20.0 } }

			add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_sell }
		}
	}
}

# Accumulate WAS/WAD and market-price sums for all goods from one
# partner state. Scope: partner state. Requires:
#   scope:stl_gravity_self = origin state
#   local_var:stl_pw       = proximity weight (100 - friction)
stl_phase_b_accumulate_all_goods = {
	# --- grain ---
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:grain } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = variable_map(stl_price|flag:grain) }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:grain } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:grain) multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_grain add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_grain add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:grain) }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:grain } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:grain) }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:grain) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_grain add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_grain add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_grain add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_grain add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fish ---
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fish } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fish) }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fish } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fish) multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fish add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fish add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fish) }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fish } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:fish) }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:fish) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fish add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fish add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fish add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_fish add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fabric ---
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fabric } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fabric) }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fabric } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fabric) multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fabric add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fabric add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fabric) }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fabric } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:fabric) }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:fabric) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fabric add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fabric add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fabric add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_fabric add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- wood ---
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:wood } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_pp value = variable_map(stl_price|flag:wood) }
		# market price accumulation (production-weighted)
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:wood } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:wood) multiply = local_var:stl_pp } }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_wood add = local_var:stl_wp }
			change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_wood add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:wood) }
		}
		# effective surplus vs origin's last-cycle market price
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:stl_gravity_self = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:wood } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = scope:stl_gravity_self.variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:wood) }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:wood) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_wood add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_wood add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_wood add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:sulfur) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_sulfur add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_sulfur add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_sulfur add = local_var:stl_wv }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:fertilizer) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_fertilizer add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_fertilizer add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_fertilizer add = local_var:stl_wv }

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_aeroplanes add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = local_var:stl_pp divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:opium) } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_was_opium add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_eff multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwas_opium add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_neg value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_eff } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_wv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = local_var:stl_pw } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wad_opium add = local_var:stl_wv }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_mwv value = { value = local_var:stl_neg multiply = 100 } }
				change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_maxwad_opium add = local_var:stl_mwv }
			}
		}
	}

			}
		}
	}
}

# Finalize one origin: fold own state into the market price, compute
# the direction-aware export/import targets, persist gravity scores.
# Scope: origin state (after the partner loop).
stl_phase_b_finalize_prices = {
	# --- grain ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:grain } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:grain } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:grain) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:grain) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_grain add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_grain add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:grain) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_grain > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_grain divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_grain } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_acc_was_grain }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_grain }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_grain }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_grain }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:grain } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:grain } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:grain } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:grain) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:grain) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:grain) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:grain } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:grain) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:grain } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:grain) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:grain } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:grain }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:grain value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:grain } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:grain }
		}
	}
	# --- fish ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fish } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fish } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fish) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fish) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fish add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fish add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fish) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fish > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fish divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fish } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fish value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:fish value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fish }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:fish value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fish }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:fish value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fish }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:fish value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fish }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fish } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fish } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fish } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:fish) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fish) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:fish) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:fish } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:fish) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:fish } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:fish) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }

		if = {

	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:groceries } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:groceries } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:groceries } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:groceries) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:groceries) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:groceries) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:groceries } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:groceries) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:groceries } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:groceries) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:groceries value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:groceries } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:groceries }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:groceries value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:groceries } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:groceries }
		}
	}
	# --- clothes ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:clothes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:clothes) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:clothes) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_clothes add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_clothes add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:clothes) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_clothes > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_clothes divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_clothes } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_was_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_clothes }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:clothes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:clothes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:clothes) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:clothes) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:clothes) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:clothes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:clothes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:clothes } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:clothes }
		}
	}
	if = {

		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:clothes value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }

		}

	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:furniture } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:furniture } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:furniture } }

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:furniture } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:furniture) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)

		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:furniture } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:furniture }
		}

		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:paper } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:paper }
		}
	}
	# --- merchant_marine ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:merchant_marine } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:merchant_marine } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:merchant_marine) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:merchant_marine) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_merchant_marine add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_merchant_marine add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:merchant_marine) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_merchant_marine > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_merchant_marine divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_merchant_marine } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_acc_was_merchant_marine }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_merchant_marine }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_merchant_marine }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_merchant_marine }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:merchant_marine } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:merchant_marine } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:merchant_marine } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:merchant_marine) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:merchant_marine) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:merchant_marine) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:merchant_marine } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:merchant_marine) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:merchant_marine } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:merchant_marine) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:merchant_marine } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:merchant_marine }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:merchant_marine value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:merchant_marine } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:merchant_marine }
		}
	}
	# --- coal ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:coal } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:coal } }

		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:coal } }

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }

			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:lead value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:lead } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:lead }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:lead value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:lead } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:lead }
		}
	}
	# --- sulfur ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:sulfur } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:sulfur } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:sulfur) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:sulfur) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_sulfur add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_sulfur add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:sulfur) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_sulfur > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_sulfur divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_sulfur } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_acc_was_sulfur }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_sulfur }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_sulfur }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_sulfur }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:sulfur } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:sulfur } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:sulfur } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:sulfur) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:sulfur) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:sulfur) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:sulfur } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:sulfur) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:sulfur } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:sulfur) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sulfur value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sulfur } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sulfur }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:sulfur } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:sulfur }
		}

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {

		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:oil) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:oil) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:oil } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:oil) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:oil } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:oil) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:oil value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:oil } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:oil }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:oil value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:oil } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:oil }
		}
	}
	# --- silk ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:silk } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:silk } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:silk) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:silk) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_silk add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_silk add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:silk) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_silk > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_silk divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_silk } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:silk value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:silk value = local_var:stl_acc_was_silk }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:silk value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_silk }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:silk value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_silk }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:silk value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_silk }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:silk } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:silk } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:silk } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:silk) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:silk) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:silk) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:silk } }

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }

		}

			if = {

		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:steamers } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:steamers } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:steamers) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:steamers) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_steamers add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_steamers add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:steamers) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steamers > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_steamers divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steamers } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_acc_was_steamers }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_steamers }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_steamers }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_steamers }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:steamers } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:steamers } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:steamers } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:steamers) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:steamers) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:steamers) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:steamers } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:steamers) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:steamers } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:steamers) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steamers } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steamers }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:steamers value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:steamers } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:steamers }
		}
	}
	# --- glass ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:glass } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:glass } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:glass) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:glass) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_glass add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_glass add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:glass) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_glass > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_glass divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_glass } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_acc_was_glass }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_glass }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_glass }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_glass }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:glass } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:glass } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:glass } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:glass) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:glass) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:glass) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:glass } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:glass) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:glass } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:glass) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:glass } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:glass }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:glass value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:glass } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:glass }
		}
	}
	# --- fertilizer ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fertilizer } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fertilizer } }

		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fertilizer add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fertilizer) }

	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fertilizer > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fertilizer divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fertilizer } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_mkt }

	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fertilizer }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fertilizer }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fertilizer }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fertilizer }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fertilizer } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fertilizer } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fertilizer } }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:fertilizer } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:fertilizer) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:fertilizer } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:fertilizer) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}

				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }

		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fertilizer } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fertilizer }
		}

	if = {

		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fertilizer value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }

		if = {

			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fertilizer }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tools value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tools } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tools }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tools value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tools } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tools }
		}
	}
	# --- steel ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:steel } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:steel } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:steel) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:steel) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_steel add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_steel add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:steel) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steel > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_steel divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_steel } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_acc_was_steel }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_steel }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_steel }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_steel }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:steel } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:steel } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:steel } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:steel) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:steel) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:steel) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:steel } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:steel) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:steel } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:steel) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steel value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steel } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:steel }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:steel } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:steel }
		}
	}

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {

	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:explosives } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:explosives) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
