		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:ammunition) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:ammunition } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:ammunition) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:ammunition value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:ammunition } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:ammunition }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:ammunition value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:ammunition } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:ammunition }
		}
	}
	# --- small_arms ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:small_arms } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:small_arms } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:small_arms) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:small_arms) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_small_arms add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_small_arms add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:small_arms) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_small_arms > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_small_arms divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_small_arms } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:small_arms value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:small_arms value = local_var:stl_acc_was_small_arms }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:small_arms value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_small_arms }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:small_arms value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_small_arms }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:small_arms value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_small_arms }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:small_arms } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:small_arms } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:small_arms } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:small_arms) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:small_arms) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:small_arms) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:small_arms } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:small_arms) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:small_arms } }

	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }

		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_aeroplanes > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_aeroplanes divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_aeroplanes } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_was_aeroplanes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_aeroplanes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_aeroplanes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_aeroplanes }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:aeroplanes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:aeroplanes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:aeroplanes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:aeroplanes) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:aeroplanes) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:aeroplanes) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:aeroplanes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:aeroplanes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:aeroplanes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:aeroplanes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:aeroplanes } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:aeroplanes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:aeroplanes value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:aeroplanes } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:aeroplanes }
		}
	}
	# --- meat ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:meat } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:meat } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:meat) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:meat) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_meat add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_meat add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:meat) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_meat > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_meat divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_meat } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_acc_was_meat }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_meat }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_meat }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_meat }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:meat } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:meat } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:meat } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:meat) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:meat) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:meat) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:meat } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:meat) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:meat } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:meat) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:meat } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:meat }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:meat value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:meat } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:meat }
		}
	}
	# --- fruit ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fruit } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fruit } }

		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fruit add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fruit) }

	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fruit > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fruit divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fruit } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fruit }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fruit }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fruit }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fruit }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets

	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fruit } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fruit } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fruit } }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:fruit } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:fruit) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:fruit } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:fruit) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }

			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}

		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fruit } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fruit }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fruit value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fruit } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fruit }
		}
	}

	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:sugar } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:sugar } }

		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_sugar add = local_var:stl_wp }

	if = {

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:sugar } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:sugar) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }

	if = {

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }

			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sugar value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sugar } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:sugar }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:sugar value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:sugar } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:sugar }
		}
	}
	# --- tobacco ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:tobacco } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:tobacco } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:tobacco) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:tobacco) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_tobacco add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_tobacco add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:tobacco) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_tobacco > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_tobacco divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_tobacco } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_acc_was_tobacco }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_tobacco }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_tobacco }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_tobacco }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:tobacco } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:tobacco } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:tobacco } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:tobacco) }

			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:tobacco) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:tobacco) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:tobacco } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:tobacco) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:tobacco } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:tobacco) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tobacco value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}

		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tea value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tea } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:tea }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tea value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tea } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:tea }
		}
	}
	# --- coffee ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:coffee } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:coffee } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:coffee) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:coffee) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_coffee add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_coffee add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:coffee) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_coffee > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_coffee divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_coffee } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_acc_was_coffee }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_coffee }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_coffee }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_coffee }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:coffee } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:coffee } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:coffee } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:coffee) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:coffee) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:coffee) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:coffee } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:coffee) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:coffee } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:coffee) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}

			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:coffee value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}

	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_luxury_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_clothes }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_luxury_clothes }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:luxury_clothes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:luxury_clothes } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:luxury_clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:luxury_clothes) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:luxury_clothes) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:luxury_clothes) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:luxury_clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:luxury_clothes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:luxury_clothes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:luxury_clothes) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_clothes } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_clothes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_clothes value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_clothes } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_clothes }
		}
	}
	# --- luxury_furniture ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:luxury_furniture } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:luxury_furniture) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:luxury_furniture) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_luxury_furniture add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:luxury_furniture) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_luxury_furniture divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_luxury_furniture } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_was_luxury_furniture }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_luxury_furniture }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_luxury_furniture }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_luxury_furniture }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:luxury_furniture } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:luxury_furniture } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:luxury_furniture) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:luxury_furniture) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:luxury_furniture) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:luxury_furniture) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:luxury_furniture) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:luxury_furniture }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {

		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_furniture } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:luxury_furniture }
		}
	}

		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}

	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_automobiles }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_automobiles }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_automobiles }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }

		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:automobiles } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:automobiles } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:automobiles } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:automobiles) }

			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:automobiles) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:automobiles) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:automobiles } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:automobiles) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:automobiles } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:automobiles) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }

				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }

		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal

				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }

		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:automobiles } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:automobiles }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:automobiles value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:automobiles } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:automobiles }
		}
	}

	if = {

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:telephones value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:telephones } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:telephones }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:telephones value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:telephones } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:telephones }
		}
	}
	# --- radios ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:radios } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:radios } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:radios) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:radios) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_radios add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_radios add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:radios) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_radios > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_radios divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_radios } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_acc_was_radios }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_radios }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_radios }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_radios }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:radios } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:radios } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:radios } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:radios) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:radios) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:radios) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:radios } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:radios) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:radios } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:radios) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:radios } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:radios }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:radios value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:radios } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:radios }
		}
	}
	# --- fine_art ---
	# fold own production x own cached price into the weighted average
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_prod key = flag:fine_art } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fine_art } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_wp value = { value = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fine_art) multiply = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fine_art) } }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_psum_fine_art add = local_var:stl_wp }
		change_local_variable = { name = stl_acc_wsum_fine_art add = variable_map(stl_prod|flag:fine_art) }
	}
	# market price (only overwritten when computable; else last cycle's stands)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fine_art > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = { value = local_var:stl_acc_psum_fine_art divide = local_var:stl_acc_wsum_fine_art } }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_mkt }
	}
	# persist gravity scores for Phase C + GUI
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_was key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_acc_was_fine_art }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_was key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwas_fine_art }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_wad key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_acc_wad_fine_art }
	add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_max_wad key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_acc_maxwad_fine_art }
	# own effective surplus -> direction-aware targets
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_econ key = flag:fine_art } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_price key = flag:fine_art } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_market_price key = flag:fine_art } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_mkt value = variable_map(stl_market_price|flag:fine_art) }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_mkt > 0.01 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_eff value = { value = local_var:stl_mkt subtract = variable_map(stl_price|flag:fine_art) divide = local_var:stl_mkt multiply = variable_map(stl_econ|flag:fine_art) } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_have_eff value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# previous applied trade (for direction persistence)
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_export key = flag:fine_art } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = variable_map(stl_last_export|flag:fine_art) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_last_import key = flag:fine_art } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = variable_map(stl_last_import|flag:fine_art) }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_have_eff >= 1 }
		# Case 1: was importing -> adjust import target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_imp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 2: was exporting -> adjust export target by eff (flip on overshoot)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_tgt_exp } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = 0 }
			}
		}
		# Case 3: no existing trade -> raw signal
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_exp value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = stl_tgt_imp value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# persist targets (sparse: only meaningful values keep a key)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_tgt_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_exp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fine_art } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_export key = flag:fine_art }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fine_art value = local_var:stl_tgt_imp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_tgt_imp > 0.005 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fine_art } }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = stl_eff_import key = flag:fine_art }
		}
	}
}
